helpIntro: Nebraska uses a 4.0 undergraduate scale. Enter semester credit hours and final grades to estimate current, cumulative, projected and target GPA.
helpNote: For standard University of Nebraska–Lincoln undergraduate GPA planning. P, N, I, W and NR are excluded. Repeat Impact is disabled because UNL repeat eligibility includes a same-or-greater-credit condition the shared tool cannot safely model. Official UNL pages conflict on whether thousandth precision is described as rounded or truncated; MyRED is authoritative.
helpExample: A 3-credit A- earns 11.01 grade points; a 3-credit B earns 9.00. Together, 20.01 ÷ 6 = 3.335.

gradeExplanations.A+: A+ = 4.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.67 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.33 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.67 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.33 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.67 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.33 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.67 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete; excluded until replaced by a final grade.
